title: Brand Manager
company: Pure Resourcing Solutions Limited - Agency - Permanent
salary_text: £40000 - £50000 per year (Hybrid Working, 3 Days on Site)
description:
Brand Manager (Direct-to-Consumer Subscription Marketing) Location: Hybrid Norwich City Centre
About the Role We're looking for an ambitious and commercially minded Brand Manager to join a fast-growing organisation operating within the health, safety and well being sector. This is an exciting opportunity to take ownership of a consumer-focused subscription proposition, driving brand growth, customer acquisition, retention and lifetime value.
Working at the intersection of brand, digital marketing and commercial performance, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping how consumers discover, engage with and remain loyal to our services. You'll be responsible for developing and delivering marketing strategies that fuel sustainable growth across direct-to-consumer channels.
This role would suit someone with strong experience in subscription-based businesses, D2 C marketing, customer life cycle management and data-driven decision making.
Key Responsibilities
- Develop and execute brand and marketing strategies to drive subscription growth and market share.
- Lead customer acquisition campaigns across digital and offline channels.
- Optimise the end-to-end customer journey, from awareness and consideration through to conversion, retention and advocacy.
- Monitor and improve key metrics including customer acquisition cost (CAC), conversion rate, churn, retention and lifetime value (LTV).
- Work closely with digital, product, sales and customer experience teams to ensure a seamless and compelling customer proposition.
- Manage agency relationships, creative development and campaign delivery.
- Use customer insights, market research and performance data to inform marketing strategy and investment decisions.
- Identify opportunities for product and proposition enhancement based on customer needs and market trends.
- Maintain brand consistency across all customer touchpoints.
- Manage marketing budgets and evaluate campaign effectiveness.

About You You'll be a strategic thinker with a strong commercial mindset and the ability to balance brand-building activities with performance marketing objectives.
Essential Experience
- Experience in a Brand Manager, Senior Marketing Manager or similar role.
- Proven success within a subscription, membership, recurring revenue or SaaS environment.
- Strong understanding of D2 C customer acquisition and retention strategies.
- Experience managing multi-channel marketing campaigns.
- Ability to analyse data and translate insights into actionable growth plans.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
- Budget management experience.

Desirable
- Experience within healthtech, care, wellbeing, connected services, telecoms, or consumer technology sectors.
- Familiarity with CRM, customer lifecycle marketing and marketing automation platforms.
- Knowledge of regulated consumer markets.

What You'll Get
- Opportunity to shape the growth of a purpose-led consumer brand.
- High visibility role with significant impact on commercial performance.
- Collaborative and supportive culture.
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Hybrid and flexible working arrangements.

Apply If you're passionate about building brands, accelerating subscription growth and delivering exceptional customer experiences, we'd love to hear from you

title: CRM Executive
company: Select Recruitment Specialists Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Ever wondered what it would be like to run CRM where your campaigns bring in tens of millions a year? Want to join a fast-growing business just as it gears up for its next big chapter?

My client is one of Norfolk's genuine success stories. They're a digital consumer business started by two local founders some years ago, and they've grown into one of the leaders in their market. They now have major new investment behind them and a brand-new leadership team, including a new MD, a new Head of Marketing and a Head of CRM being appointed now. They're building a stronger marketing team, and this CRM Executive role is a key part of it.

CRM isn't a side function here. It's one of the biggest revenue drivers in the business. They're volume driven and growth focused, so your work on targeting, retention and reactivation shows up in the numbers fast.

What you'll be doing
- Building, testing and deploying campaigns across email, SMS and app push, and helping manage the campaign calendar.
- Supporting and improving automated journeys across onboarding, retention, reactivation and engagement.
- Building audiences from behavioural and transactional data, and keeping targeting sharp.
- Adding personalised and dynamic content, and running A/B tests.
- Reporting on engagement, revenue, retention and ROI, and turning the results into ideas.
- Working with creative, paid media, product and data colleagues, plus external agencies.

What you'll bring
- Strong, proven experience in CRM, email or lifecycle marketing.
- Hands-on experience of customer and market segmentation. This is a must.
- A track record of using CRM to drive retention, growth, activation and ROI.
- Experience in Klaviyo is ideal, but another CRM platform is absolutely fine if you're keen to learn.
- Sharp attention to detail, strong organisation, and a commercial head.
- A full driving licence and your own transport, as the site isn't on a public transport route (20 min walk from nearest station).

What's in it for you
- A salary of £30,000 £35,000, depending on experience.
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.
- A 7.5% matched pension.
- Free parking on site.
- Food and refreshments provided every week.
- Summer and winter socials abroad.
- A young, sociable team with a great culture and a real chance to grow with the business.

Interested? My client wants to move quickly, with interviews happening straight away for the right people. If this sounds like you, get in touch with Emma Baylis at Select Recruitment Specialists today for a confidential chat.

title: Marketing & Social Media Executive
description:
We are looking for a commercially minded Marketing & Social Media Executive to join our small & ambitious Marketing Team. You ll take ownership of engaging content and organic social media while supporting SEO, paid social, digital PR and website development. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines creativity with data-led thinking and understands how great content drives traffic, enquiries and sales.

What you ll do
- Plan, create and manage content across website, Instagram, Facebook and other digital channels.
- Own the content calendar, organic social activity and community engagement
- Write website, product, campaign, blog and customer-story content
- Support SEO, digital PR, link building and paid social campaigns
- Work with colleagues, agencies, photographers and videographers to produce strong creative assets
- Track performance using GA4, Google Search Console, SEMrush and social reporting tools, turning insight into clear actions.
- Help set meaningful KPI S for content, social media, SEO and digital campaigns, aligned with wider business objectives
- Analyse engagement, rankings, enquiries, conversion rates and cost per lead to understand which activity delivers the strongest commercial return.
- Produce clear monthly reports that explain performance, identify opportunities and recommend actions to improve the quality and volume of sales enquiries.

What were looking for in a Marketing & Social Media Exec:

We are looking for someone who combines creativity with commercial awareness. You should enjoy developing engaging content but also want to understand how that content performs and how it contributes to traffic, enquiries and ultimately sales.

You will be naturally curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working with data and prepared to challenge or change marketing activity when the results suggest a different approach is needed.
- At least two years experience in a marketing, content or social media role.
- Excellent copywriting, proofreading and editing skills.
- Experience creating commercial website and campaign content and managing business social accounts.
- Data driven with a good working knowledge of SEO and digital performance reporting
- An organised, proactive approach, strong attention to detail and a creative eye.
- Experience with paid social, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Acrobat or Canva is advantageous.

Rewards & benefits being offered:
- £30,000 £35,000 salary, depending on experience.
- Hybrid working: three days in the office and two from home
- 28 days annual leave increasing with length of service
- Health Shield healthcare cash plan
- Death in service insurance
- Contributory pension scheme
- Excellent staff facilities with full equipped kitchen area
- Opportunity to use the company holiday home
- On site parking

Interested? Apply today with your CV and tell us how your content and social media experience could help grow the Crane Garden Buildings brand.

title: Ppc
description:
We have an exciting role with our client based in Norwich who are looking to recruit a Biddable Manager to manage their large paid social media and PPC campaigns. This role is offering flexibility for home working.

The role responsibility will be to drive the maximum number of quality leads into the business.

Main Responsibilities
- Management of Paid Social channels for 3 national market leading brands with laser focus on ROI.
- Working with eight figure budgets on diverse range of biddable accounts, platforms (e.g. Meta, Google & Microsoft) and campaign types (e.g. Paid Social, Search, Pmax, Demand Gen).
- Developing & implementing audience (including first party data) and creative strategies which drive performance and growth for paid social channels.
- Optimising and briefing the wider team to create bespoke landing pages for paid social to maximise the volume of high-quality leads.
- Manage bids utilising an array of fully automated bidding solutions to offline conversion actions.
- Digital agency and supplier liaison from tech providers and key media owners including Google, Meta, Microsoft Ads.
- Collaborate with an award-winning London based Search agency to implement cutting edge PPC technology.
- Collaborate with tech platform Account and Industry managers to optimise campaigns and drive performance delivery.
- Martech usage including Google Marketing Platform (Campaign Manager, Search Ads 360, Display Video 360). Other martech including Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, Bing Ads, Bot Management tool.
- Report into Biddable Media Lead to ensure all activity falls in line with the wider paid media strategy.

Performance measures
- Primary Paid Media metrics such as cost per acquisition and return on investment/advertising spend.
- Secondary Paid Media metrics including of cost per click, click through rate, conversion rate.
- Spend to planned budget & cost of sale % by region by product.

Knowledge and Experience
- Digital marketing background (either client or agency side).
- Minimum of 2-4 years' experience of hands-on management of large paid social campaigns and budgets.
- Excellent analytical skills.
- Able to communicate effectively in verbal and written formats.
- Proficient user of Microsoft packages.
- Knowledge of Google Marketing Platform particularly CM & SA360.
- Experience in Lead Generation preferrable
- Knowledge of Google Ads and Microsoft Ads interfaces and Editors (although full training will be given).
- Specific Digital Marketing qualifications.
- Meta Blueprint certified

Please apply with your updated CV.
